2025-09-15.title: Assistant project testing
2025-09-15.summary:
You’re reviving your personal assistant project using Growth-Kinetics/DiffMem to test and improve memory persistence and reasoning. The core test involves teaching the assistant its “birthday,” querying it repeatedly over days, and asking how many times the birthday has been queried, verifying recall, persistence, and counting.

The updated plan integrates DiffMem’s episodic/semantic memory model with Git-backed persistence and a Streamlit UI for conversation control. Key steps include initializing DiffMem with a birthday fact, building a chat UI to mark memories, syncing memory files with Git (pull on startup, commit/push on inactivity), and implementing logic to log and count birthday queries.

DiffMem stores conversational memory as Markdown files with BM25 indexing for retrieval but lacks automatic Git sync and concurrency controls, which you plan to add. You’ll also implement intent detection, event logging, controlled commits, and testing across multiple sessions to ensure robust, versioned memory management and reasoning over time.

2025-09-14.title: Cancer cells vs viruses
2025-09-14.summary:
Viruses and prions are not living cells. Viruses lack cellular structures and metabolism, requiring host cells to replicate, so they’re classified as acellular infectious agents rather than living organisms. Prions are simpler—misfolded proteins without genetic material or metabolism—that propagate by inducing misfolding in normal proteins but do not perform life processes. Thus, neither meet criteria for living cells.

2025-09-11.title: Message tightening suggestions
2025-09-11.summary: To enlarge your dorodango ball without access to loose dirt, mix kaolin clay with fine powdered materials like fine sand, bentonite or ball clay, powdered chalk, or pottery clay powder to add bulk and texture. Use coarse materials sparingly to maintain moldability. For the smoothest, shiniest finish, apply ultra-fine clays in the final layers—pure kaolin is best for tight compaction and satin gloss, followed by ball or porcelain clay powder for a denser, silkier surface. Bentonite adds gloss but risks cracking if overused. Avoid gritty materials on outer layers to ensure polishability. A recommended method is building a core with kaolin plus some sand, then a transition layer mostly kaolin, finishing with a 1–2 mm pure kaolin or kaolin+bentonite layer. Polish gently as it dries and buff with a microfiber cloth for maximum shine. The user seeks specific ball or porcelain clay powders that complement kaolin for an extra glossy final layer.
